name: Pioneer Venus Orbiter
about: Pioneer Venus Orbiter (1978-051A, ARC), launched 1978 May 20. Its phases from GCAT: Venus, HCO. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was
